# Same assay record

The immunology report should include the assay date.

# Same assay record

The immunology report should not include the assay date.

# Same access policy

The gateway should record failed authentication attempts.

# Same access policy

The gateway should not record failed authentication attempts.

# Policy of unspecified authority

The gateway must retain access logs.

# Recommendation of unspecified authority

The gateway should not retain access logs.

# Same scheduled report

The scheduled report will contain the assay date.

# Same scheduled report

The scheduled report will not contain the assay date.

# Distinct records

The adult report should include the assay date.

# Distinct records

The pediatric report should not include the assay date.

# Explicit consent condition

When consent has been recorded, the report should include the identifier.

# Explicit consent condition

When consent has not been recorded, the report should not include the identifier.

# Different moments

Before key rotation, the service should accept the previous key.

# Different moments

After key rotation, the service should not accept the previous key.

# Current policy

The gateway should retain access logs.

# Historical policy, no longer applicable

The gateway should not retain access logs.

# Same record

The immunology report should include the assay date.

# Same record

The immunology report should include the assay date.

# Same access policy

The gateway should not record secret authentication values.

# Same access policy

The gateway should not record secret authentication values.

# Same collection of reports

All reports should include the assay date.

# Same collection of reports

At least one report should not include the assay date.

# Distinct environments

The production service should retain access logs.

# Distinct environments

The training service should not retain access logs.

# Unresolved reference

This should be retained in the record.

# Unresolved reference

That should not be retained in the record.

# Same set of reports

The reports should remain confidential.

# Same set of reports

The reports should be publicly disclosed.

# Distinct fields

The report should include the collection date.

# Distinct fields

The report should not include the publication date.

# Same backups

The encrypted backups should be retained for ten years.

# Same backups

The encrypted backups should not be retained for ten years.
